_note: UI copy for the auto-generated plan pages and catalogs (site/planes/p/, site/en/plans/p/, site/pt/planos/p/, and the three catalog index pages). Written natively per language, not machine-translated — matches the vos/vous register the rest of the site already uses (not the tu form brand-guidelines.md nominally calls for; the live site is consistently vos in Spanish, this follows it). Distance/focus values from the inventory (Sprint, Olympic, HYROX, Base, FTP...) are shown as-is in every language — they're used as loanwords in ES/PT endurance-sport content and a clean per-value translation table isn't worth building for Phase 1.
